name: Casino / Slots
concept_focus: Randomness, probability and bankroll state, then simulations that measure and tune a game

story.title: The Silver Reels
story.client: Auditor Pell of the Gaming Guild
story.hook: The Silver Reels casino swears its machines are fair. Pell has been sent to prove otherwise and needs someone who can build a slot machine, then measure one: millions of spins, the real return, and the tricks that hide in the weights.

acts.title: Act I: The Machine
acts.goal: A bankroll, three reels, a payout table and bets that cannot be faked.

acts.title: Act II: The Session
acts.goal: Odds you can reason about, a session loop, named functions and a summary when you walk away.

acts.title: Act III: The Audit
acts.goal: Weighted reels, a million-spin simulation, a balanced payout table, a jackpot, a second game and responsible limits.

boss_lore: Lady Luck never lies about a single spin. She lies about the thousandth one, where nobody is counting.
boss_brief: Bring a finished casino.py: weighted reels with a payout table checked from most to least valuable, validated bets, a session summary, a simulation that measures the real return to player, a table tuned to a target return, a progressive jackpot, roulette on the same bankroll, and session limits.

mobs.name: The Coin Rat
mobs.encounter: Track a starting bankroll and explain which actions should make it grow or shrink.
mobs.contract: Something gnaws at the bankroll between spins. Keep the purse in one honest variable and know every reason it changes.

objectives.label: Keep the purse
objectives.brief: In casino.py, start the player with a bankroll and show it before every spin.

objectives.label: Take a bet, pay a win
objectives.brief: Take a fixed bet out of the bankroll for each spin and add any winnings back.

objectives.label: List every change
objectives.brief: List every line that changes the bankroll and explain why each one is allowed to.

mobs.name: The Spin Imp
mobs.encounter: Generate three random symbols per spin and reason about how many different outcomes are possible.
mobs.contract: The Imp spins the reels and grins. Three symbols, chosen fresh each time, and you should know how many outcomes there are.

objectives.label: Spin three reels
objectives.brief: Keep the symbols in a list and pick one at random for each of three reels, then show the line.

objectives.label: Count the outcomes
objectives.brief: Predict how many different three-symbol lines your reels can make, then compute it in code.

objectives.label: Spin each reel separately
objectives.brief: Explain why [random.choice(symbols)] * 3 always shows three of a kind, and show your reels spin independently.

mobs.name: The Payout Mimic
mobs.encounter: Reward different combinations correctly and decide what order to check them in so a big win is never paid as a small one.
mobs.contract: The Mimic pays three sevens as a pair of cherries. Check the big wins first and keep the prices in one table.

objectives.label: Write the payout table
objectives.brief: Keep payouts in a dictionary: three of each symbol, any two matching, and special cherry rules.

objectives.label: Check big wins first
objectives.brief: Work out the payout for a line, checking the most valuable combinations first.

objectives.label: Explain the order
objectives.brief: Show a line your program would underpay if it checked pairs before three of a kind, and explain why the order matters.

mobs.name: The Debt Ghoul
mobs.encounter: Block bets that are negative, zero, not a number or bigger than the bankroll, and ask again instead of crashing.
mobs.contract: The Ghoul feeds on bets you cannot cover. Refuse every bad bet and every fake number at the door.

objectives.label: Ask for a bet
objectives.brief: Let the player choose their bet each spin, converting the text to a number.

objectives.label: Refuse bad bets
objectives.brief: Ask again on text, zero, negative numbers or more than the bankroll, without crashing.

objectives.label: Show what it survives
objectives.brief: List the inputs that used to crash or cheat your game and what it does with each now.

mobs.name: The House Edge
mobs.encounter: Estimate how often each combination should appear and judge whether your payouts let a player win forever.
mobs.contract: Pell's first lesson: every machine is a maths problem. Work out how often each line should appear and what the machine pays back on average.

objectives.label: Work out the odds
objectives.brief: Compute, in code, the probability of three of a kind for each symbol and of any pair.

objectives.label: Compute the expected return
objectives.brief: Combine those odds with your payout table into the expected return per unit bet.

objectives.label: Judge the edge
objectives.brief: Explain whether your machine favours the house or the player, and by how much per hundred spins.

mobs.name: The Greed Spirit
mobs.encounter: Keep the game running across many spins and explain every condition that ends the session.
mobs.contract: Greed whispers one more spin. Give the session a loop, and make sure every way out actually works.

objectives.label: Keep spinning
objectives.brief: Loop spins until the player cashes out or cannot afford the smallest bet.

objectives.label: Cash out
objectives.brief: Let the player cash out at any bet prompt and show what they leave with.

objectives.label: List the exits
objectives.brief: List every condition that ends the session and show one that used to keep it running when it should have stopped.

mobs.name: The Croupier
mobs.encounter: Split taking bets, spinning and paying out into named behaviours with clear inputs and returns.
mobs.contract: A good croupier does three jobs, each perfectly, never mixed up. Give your machine the same discipline.

objectives.label: Write spin
objectives.brief: Write spin() that returns a line of three symbols and nothing else.

objectives.label: Write payout
objectives.brief: Write payout(line, bet) that returns winnings without touching the bankroll or printing.

objectives.label: Explain the split
objectives.brief: Explain why payout must not change the bankroll itself, and how that helps you test it.

mobs.name: The Tally Ghost
mobs.encounter: Track wins, losses and net change across the session and present a clear summary when the player walks away.
mobs.contract: The Ghost keeps the books nobody else wants to keep. Every spin, every win, and the truth at the end of the night.

objectives.label: Keep the books
objectives.brief: Track spins, wins, the biggest win, total bet and total won in one dictionary.

objectives.label: Print the summary
objectives.brief: When the session ends, print a clear summary with net change and win rate.

objectives.label: Check the maths
objectives.brief: Predict the summary for a short scripted session (fix the random seed), then check it.

mobs.name: The Weighted Reel
mobs.encounter: Make some symbols rarer than others with weights.
mobs.contract: Pell opened a Silver Reels machine and found the secret: the sevens are painted on fewer slots. Real reels are weighted. Build yours the same way.

objectives.label: Weight the symbols
objectives.brief: Give each symbol a weight in a dictionary and spin with random.choices using them.

objectives.label: Recompute the odds
objectives.brief: Update your probability code to use the weights, and show the new expected return.

objectives.label: Explain the trick
objectives.brief: Explain how weighting lets a machine show sevens often but pay them rarely.

mobs.name: The Million Spins
mobs.encounter: Spin a million times and measure the real return to player.
mobs.contract: Maths says one thing. The machine does another. Run it a million times and see who is right.

objectives.label: Spin a million times
objectives.brief: Simulate a million spins without printing and measure the return to player as a percentage.

objectives.label: Compare with theory
objectives.brief: Show the simulated return next to your calculated expected return.

objectives.label: Explain the gap
objectives.brief: Explain why the two numbers are close but not equal, and how the gap changes with fewer spins.

mobs.name: The Balancer
mobs.concept: Tuning a table to a target
mobs.encounter: Adjust the payout table until the return hits a target.
mobs.contract: The Guild's law: every machine returns between 94 and 96 percent. Tune your table until yours obeys.

objectives.label: Tune automatically
objectives.brief: Adjust one payout step by step, recomputing the expected return, until it lands between 94 and 96 percent.

objectives.label: Verify by simulation
objectives.brief: Confirm the tuned table with a simulation and print both numbers.

objectives.label: Defend your choice
objectives.brief: Explain which payout you tuned and how it changes how the machine feels to play.

mobs.name: The Jackpot Hoard
mobs.encounter: Add a progressive jackpot that grows with every bet.
mobs.contract: Every bet feeds the hoard a little. One lucky line takes it all and it starts again.

objectives.label: Grow the hoard
objectives.brief: Put a percentage of every bet into a jackpot that is shown on screen.

objectives.label: Pay the hoard
objectives.brief: Pay the whole jackpot on a special line and reset it to its seed value.

objectives.label: Account for the hoard
objectives.brief: Explain how the jackpot changes the return-to-player maths, and fix your simulation so it counts it.

mobs.name: The Roulette Wheel
mobs.concept: A second game on shared functions
mobs.encounter: Add roulette using the same bankroll and bet handling.
mobs.contract: The Reels has a wheel too. Reuse your bankroll and betting code so a second game costs you only its own rules.

objectives.label: Spin the wheel
objectives.brief: Spin a roulette wheel of 0 to 36 with red and black numbers.

objectives.label: Take roulette bets
objectives.brief: Support betting on a number, red or black, and odd or even, with the right payouts.

objectives.label: Show the reuse
objectives.brief: Explain which of your functions both games share and what you had to change to share them.

mobs.name: The Guardian of Limits
mobs.encounter: Add loss limits and a saved bankroll.
mobs.contract: Pell's report needs one more page: a machine that protects the player from themselves. Set limits, and remember the purse between visits.

objectives.label: Set a loss limit
objectives.brief: Let the player set a loss limit at the start and end the session when it is reached.

objectives.label: Remember the purse
objectives.brief: Save the bankroll and lifetime stats to a JSON file and load them on start.

objectives.label: Open the floor
objectives.brief: Add a menu: slots, roulette, run an audit simulation, view stats, or leave.
